old_caption: The video captures an intense scene of a large fire burning through a field of dry grass. The flames are vividly bright orange and yellow, consuming the vegetation and sending thick plumes of dark smoke billowing into the air. The smoke is dense and heavy, obscuring parts of the field and creating a dramatic contrast against the fiery blaze. As the fire progresses, it spreads across the landscape, engulfing more of the dry grass. The surrounding area appears to be a vast open field, with no visible structures or people in sight. The fire's intensity fluctuates slightly throughout the sequence, with some areas of the flames appearing more vigorous than others. The overall atmosphere is one of urgency and danger, highlighting the destructive power of wildfires.

caption: The video captures a grass fire already burning across a field of dry, tan vegetation. A bright arc of orange-yellow flames runs along the lower edge of a dark, charred and smoldering patch of scorched ground. A second flame line curves up the left side of that patch, licking at the standing grass. Thick grey-white smoke billows upward and drifts toward the upper-left corner, partially veiling the background. The flames continuously flicker, change height, and re-ignite in small tongues, while the overall fire boundary stays roughly in place. Within the dark center, occasional small flame bursts appear and fade without rearranging the surrounding layout of the field. A dirt track with a few tiny distant figures remains visible along the very top edge of the frame.

infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.

and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.

Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
